overview_description.description: Lookout, Inc. is the endpoint to cloud security company purpose-built for the intersection of enterprise and personal data. We safeguard data across devices, apps, networks and clouds through our unified, cloud-native security platform — a solution that's as fluid and flexible as the modern digital world. By giving organizations and individuals greater control over their data, we enable them to unleash its value and thrive. Lookout is trusted by enterprises of all sizes, government agencies and millions of consumers to protect sensitive data, enabling them to live, work and connect — freely and safely.

about_short_description.short_description: Lookout, Inc. is the endpoint to cloud security company purpose-built for the intersection of enterprise and personal data.

product.name: Lookout Mobile Endpoint Security
product.description: Protects iOS and Android devices from mobile threats by scanning applications, monitoring network activity, detecting device compromise, and enforcing security policies.

product.name: Lookout Mobile EDR
product.description: Provides real-time monitoring, detection, investigation, and response for mobile devices, with forensic data that can be integrated into EDR and SIEM systems.

product.name: Lookout Phishing Protection
product.description: Detects and blocks phishing attacks delivered through emails, websites, and messages that attempt to steal credentials or other sensitive information.

product.name: Lookout Smishing Protection
product.description: Detects and blocks SMS-based phishing attempts that use malicious links, requests for sensitive information, or malware installation prompts.

product.name: Lookout Executive Impersonation Protection
product.description: Identifies and blocks attacks in which criminals impersonate executives to induce payments, data disclosure, or other risky employee actions.

product.name: Lookout Threat Intelligence Services
product.description: Provides intelligence on mobile attackers, tactics, vulnerabilities, malware, and indicators of compromise to support prevention, detection, and response.
